name: Rhinag
summary: Near Durotar’s northwestern border, Rhinag waits among the rocks, weakened by scorpids’ venom. The Darkspear troll needs a remedy from a passing traveler before the poison takes its toll.

sections.title: A Venomous Peril
sections.body: Among the rocks near Durotar’s northwestern border, Rhinag lies weak after a Venomtail Scorpid stung him. The poison has left the Darkspear troll isolated. He needs a venomtail antidote, and his survival depends on whether a passing traveler can find one in time.

faq.answer: Rhinag is a Darkspear jungle troll traveler, stranded and weakened near Durotar’s northwestern border after a scorpion’s sting.
Rhinag rests among the rocks near Durotar’s northwestern border.
A Venomtail Scorpid stung Rhinag while he crossed Durotar. Its poison left him incapacitated, and he needs an antidote before it proves fatal.

angles.text: As a troll, you may find a kinsman brought low by Durotar’s native wildlife. The Darkspear tribe faces many trials as it makes a home alongside the Horde.
